stories.title: Circle asks SEC to scrap a stablecoin-limiting Wall Street rule
stories.summary: Circle asked the SEC to remove a rule that limits stablecoins. CryptoSlate reports the rule adds cost for stablecoin issuers. Circle says the rule holds back the stablecoin market.
stories.whyItMatters: The SEC's decision could change how stablecoins work on Wall Street. Readers who track stablecoin rules should watch this closely.
whatToWatch: The SEC's response to Circle's request.
Any change to the rule's timeline.
questions: Which specific rule does Circle want removed?
Will the SEC act on the request?

sources.title: Circle wants SEC to erase a costly Wall Street rule holding stablecoins back

stories.title: XRP ETF investors hold on despite a 25% price crash
stories.summary: An XRP-linked ETF tracked by CryptoSlate fell 25% in price. Investors did not sell their ETF tokens despite the drop. The report says holders kept their positions.
stories.whyItMatters: The move tests investor confidence in XRP products during a sharp price decline.
whatToWatch: Whether holders stay in the position.
Future price moves in the XRP ETF.
questions: What caused the 25% crash?
Will sentiment shift if the price falls further?

sources.title: Crypto investors refuse to sell XRP ETF tokens despite a 25% price crash

stories.title: Bitcoin developers rush to fix 3 security flaws found by AI
stories.summary: AI tools found three security flaws in Bitcoin's code. Bitcoin developers now work to fix the flaws. CryptoSlate did not give further detail on the flaws' severity.
stories.whyItMatters: Security flaws in Bitcoin's core code could affect the safety of the network and user funds.
whatToWatch: When developers release the fixes.
Any disclosure of the flaws' technical details.
questions: How severe are the three flaws?
Could the flaws have been exploited before discovery?

sources.title: Bitcoin developers rush to fix 3 security flaws after AI uncovers them

stories.title: NYSE owner takes stake in Trade[XYZ], plans US Hyperliquid futures
stories.summary: The owner of the NYSE took a stake in Trade[XYZ]. The company also plans to launch Hyperliquid futures in the US. CryptoSlate reports this links a major exchange operator to the crypto derivatives market.
stories.whyItMatters: A traditional exchange operator's entry into Hyperliquid futures signals growing institutional interest in crypto derivatives.
whatToWatch: The launch date for the US Hyperliquid futures product.
Regulatory approval steps for the new product.
questions: How large is the NYSE owner's stake in Trade[XYZ]?
Will US regulators approve the futures product quickly?

sources.title: NYSE owner takes Trade[XYZ] stake as it plans US Hyperliquid futures

stories.title: Strategy's STRC nears $100, a level that could reopen a Bitcoin funding channel
stories.summary: Strategy's STRC instrument nears the $100 price level. CryptoSlate reports this level could reopen a funding channel the company uses for Bitcoin purchases. The company has used similar instruments to fund its Bitcoin holdings before.
stories.whyItMatters: A reopened funding channel could let Strategy buy more Bitcoin, a move that affects Bitcoin's supply and price narrative.
whatToWatch: Whether STRC reaches the $100 level.
Any new Bitcoin purchase announcement from Strategy.
questions: How much capital could the funding channel raise?
Will Strategy use the channel right away if it reopens?

sources.title: Strategy’s STRC nears $100 level that could reopen a Bitcoin funding channel

stories.title: Only 10% of FOMO app's Solana wallets were profitable after fees
stories.summary: A report found that only 10% of wallets on the FOMO app were profitable after fees. The app runs on the Solana network. The CryptoSlate report suggests most users lost money once fees were counted.
stories.whyItMatters: The finding adds to concerns that fees erode retail returns on many Solana apps.
whatToWatch: Whether the FOMO app changes its fee structure.
Further data on user profit across similar apps.
questions: How does the FOMO app's fee structure compare to other Solana apps?
What is the sample size behind the 10% figure?

sources.title: Only 10% of FOMO app’s Solana wallets were profitable after fees

stories.title: Mystery whale pulls $290 million from DeFi nightly, Aave rates triple
stories.summary: A whale wallet reportedly pulls $290 million from DeFi positions every midnight. CryptoSlate reports the activity pushed Aave's borrowing rates to triple their normal level. The identity of the whale is not known.
stories.whyItMatters: Large, repeated withdrawals can strain lending pools and raise borrowing costs for other DeFi users.
whatToWatch: Whether the nightly withdrawal pattern continues.
Any change in Aave's borrowing rates.
questions: Who controls the whale wallet?
Why does the withdrawal happen at midnight each day?

sources.title: Mystery whale pulls $290 million from DeFi every midnight as Aave borrowing rates triple

stories.title: Kalshi's Senate contracts can settle on different answers to the same election
stories.summary: Kalshi offers prediction market contracts on Senate races. CryptoSlate reports that some of these contracts can settle on different answers for the same election. The report raises questions about how Kalshi resolves conflicting outcomes.
stories.whyItMatters: Inconsistent settlement rules could hurt trust in prediction markets that increasingly overlap with crypto trading platforms.
whatToWatch: Whether Kalshi clarifies or changes its settlement rules.
Any regulatory response to the discrepancy.
questions: How does Kalshi decide which answer governs a contract?
Have any traders been hurt by the conflicting settlements?

sources.title: Kalshi’s Senate contracts can settle on different answers to the same election

stories.title: HTX exits the UK, gives customers a 48-hour withdrawal window
stories.summary: The crypto exchange HTX leaves the UK market. CryptoSlate reports customers must request withdrawals within a 48-hour window. The exit affects UK-based users of the exchange.
stories.whyItMatters: An exchange exit can force users to move funds quickly. It also signals tighter conditions for offshore exchanges in the UK.
whatToWatch: The deadline for UK customers to withdraw funds.
Whether other exchanges face similar UK restrictions.
questions: Why does HTX exit the UK now?
What happens to funds not withdrawn in time?

sources.title: HTX exits UK, leaving customers to request a 48-hour withdrawal window

stories.title: Multicoin wants to turn AI chips into collateral for crypto lending
stories.summary: Multicoin wants to use AI chips as collateral for crypto loans. CryptoSlate reports the firm sees this as a path to a new lending boom. Details on how the collateral model would work are limited.
stories.whyItMatters: AI hardware as loan collateral would create a new asset class for crypto lending, a mix of two hot markets.
whatToWatch: Any pilot program or partner announcement from Multicoin.
How lenders would value and sell AI chip collateral.
questions: How would lenders value and sell chip collateral?
Which lenders or platforms would take part?

sources.title: Multicoin wants to turn AI chips into collateral for crypto’s next lending boom
